commit_sha_note: Null by construction: this receipt is committed INSIDE the commit it describes, so it cannot contain that commit's own hash. Unlike a queue archive there is no queue field to carry the sha, because this opening is deliberately not modelled as a queue task (see below); the commit is identified by its parent, its declared path set, and the per-path hashes recorded here.
path_sha256_note: The receipt's own hash is necessarily absent from this map, for the same reason commit_sha is null. The other three are the pre-commit working-tree hashes and are verifiable against the committed blobs.

not_a_queue_archive.reason: tools/research_dispatch.py requires archive.source_task_ids to be nonempty and forbids an archive claiming another archive, so an opening snapshot that has no producer task to claim is not expressible as a queue archive. Modelling it as one and then amending it is what GOAL-HAWK-001 BATCH-001 had to do (its TASK-20260802-003 archive block was removed by amendment for exactly this reason). This batch avoids the amendment by not modelling it as a queue task in the first place.
not_a_queue_archive.consequence: This receipt is NOT verified by the dispatcher. It is an auditable record of what the opening commit changed, checkable by hand against git diff-tree.
not_a_queue_archive.queue_ownership: dispatch_queue.json is committed here at its BATCH-001-opening state and is thereafter owned by the ledger archive TASK-20260802-a157ad, which commits its terminal state. It is deliberately NOT included in the snapshot archive TASK-20260802-a3dc0a's declared paths, so the snapshot must be staged by exact pathspec rather than git add -A.
